goal: Submit one save request while an existing save is pending
scope: Save form pending-state behavior and its regression checks
unchanged: A failed save can be retried
non_goals: Changing request payloads or retrying automatically

criteria.method: Delay the save response, then click Save twice
criteria.expected: Exactly one request is observed before the response

criteria.method: Make the first save fail, then click Save again
criteria.expected: One new request is observed after the failure
